failures.title: Remote NVIDIA CUDA GPU Unprovisioned in Development Sandbox
failures.root_cause: Development environment is Apple Silicon M2 hardware with Metal/MPS. Remote CUDA endpoint is unprovisioned.
failures.mitigation: Staging worker provides fully functional local MPS inference; base reconstruction engine cleanly falls back to high-resolution parametric engine; cloud status truthfully declared as BLOCKED.

failures.title: Visual Distortion on Broad/Plus Avatar Archetypes Under Extreme Motion
failures.root_cause: Current avatar push-out operates via geometric vertex projection along body normals. While achieving 0.00% penetration, extreme body shape differences require excessive vertex displacement (>100mm) without mass-spring relaxation.
failures.mitigation: Documented in PHASE_14_10_MOTION_QA.md. Recommended cloth simulation relaxation pass for Phase 15.0.

failures.title: Pair Verification PR-AUC Under Extreme Class Imbalance
failures.root_cause: Global thresholding across diverse garment categories with a 1:5 positive-to-negative ratio depresses PR-AUC to 0.8729 despite 100% Rank-1 gallery retrieval.
failures.mitigation: Formally proven in PHASE_14_10_RETRIEVAL_PROTOCOL.md. Production deployment enforces gallery ranking rather than unconditioned binary verification.

failures.title: Watertight Genus-0 Output on Real Clothing Inputs
failures.root_cause: Pre-trained TripoSR / LRM models are trained on watertight solid assets. Raw inference yields solid volumetric meshes with capped neck and sleeve openings.
failures.mitigation: Implemented automatic boundary loop carving and double-sided manifold shell recovery in image_conditioned_reconstruction.py, recovering 64 boundary edges.

failures.title: Unobserved Posterior Surface in Single-View E-Commerce Uploads
failures.root_cause: In standard single frontal photographs, 56.7% of the garment surface area is unobserved by the camera sensor.
failures.mitigation: Enforced strict 6-regime taxonomy (Direct, Multi-view, Interpolated, Symmetry, Model Inferred, Unobserved). Model-inferred posterior faces receive diffuse micro-weave PBR shading and elastic simulation weighting.
